description: In every structure, a ground relation atom \(R(\bar t)\) is true exactly when the interpreted relation holds of the actual argument term values.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.relation_truth.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {n : ℕ}
  (R : L.Relations n) (ts : Fin n → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L) (M : Type w)
  [L.Structure M] :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Atom.rel R ts).Realize M ↔
    FirstOrder.Language.Structure.RelMap R fun i => FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize Empty.elim (ts i)
